title: GLM 5.2 launch boosts coding AI with 1M token memory, local use #GLM5 #AIlaunch #OpenSourceAI
description: China launched GLM 5.2, a powerful open source AI model that surpasses Claude Code in coding capabilities and performance. It features a massive 1 million token context window and persistent memory, enabling it to handle long, multi-step projects efficiently. GLM 5.2 can be run locally without the need for API token costs, offering developers greater control and cost savings. Its ease of installation and significant performance improvements position it as a major advancement in AI coding tools this year. This development highlights a growing trend in AI toward more accessible, high-capacity models that empower users with enhanced functionality and autonomy, impacting the software development and AI research landscape. #GLM5_2 #ClaudeCode #OpenSourceAI #AIcoding #ArtificialIntelligence #AImodel #ChinaAI #MachineLearning #DeveloperTools #TechInnovation #LocalAI #PersistentMemory #LongContextAI #AI2024 #AICodingTools
